needed.suggestion: Install a continuous and usable sidewalk along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian space.
Resurface and level the narrow and damaged left-side footway to eliminate trip hazards and ensure pedestrian safety.
Install additional street lights along the road to enhance visibility, especially in evening and nighttime hours.
